about.en: Lighter is a ZK rollup on Ethereum whose ZkLighter contract queues L1 operations, such as deposits, as priority requests the sequencer must process. Each request gets a serial id, a uint64 that ZkLighter assigns on-chain and emits in NewPriorityRequest alongside the operation's pubdata. Lighter serves the resulting L2 transaction under a synthetic hash whose first 8 bytes are that serial id, big-endian, followed by the pubdata, so the L1 transaction and Lighter's record of it both yield the serial id. The key covers L1 priority requests only; withdrawal payouts on Ethereum carry no serial id.
